symptom: PR discovery succeeds after a repository transfer or rename, but Review rejects the canonical PR URL against the old remote spelling and fails with FORGE_CONTRACT_INVALID.
rule: Resolve canonical repository identity at the shared hosted-operation boundary and exercise discovery through the real Review handler. Keep reads free of Git mutations; explicit Local repair follows the saved repository ID and preserves auth, config and cache generations. See agents/zstack/changes/github-review-canonical-target.md.
